title: From Mon 16 Nov 2026 realme's after-sales network in India grows to 670+ service centres across 550+ cities, built on OPPO's existing service facilities, with realme branding kept at the centres; realme owners can also use OPPO's upgraded repair network in select locations (Beebom). 1,500+ certified engineers, genuine spare parts. A joint monthly Service Day for realme and OPPO owners: labour charges waived, discounts on screen, battery and back-panel repairs, free cleaning, screen protector and software update. No discount amounts, Service Day date, OPPO-vs-realme site split or warranty change given.
